evals.name: nodejs-complete-init
evals.prompt: I have a Node.js caching library project at /tmp/init-opensource-workspace/iteration-1/nodejs-demo. I want to prepare it for open-source publication. Please help me initialize all necessary files: git + gitignore, LICENSE (MIT), CODE_OF_CONDUCT, CONTRIBUTING guide, issue/PR templates, and a README with badges. Also ask me about multi-language support. When asking about each step, I'll confirm yes to all steps. For badges, I want npm version, npm downloads, and license badges. For the GitHub repo, assume owner is 'alicedev' and repo is 'fast-cache'.
evals.expected_output: All open-source files generated: .gitignore, LICENSE, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, README.md with badges and cross-references

evals.name: python-partial-init

It already has a basic README.md that just says '# Data Validator' and a short description. I want to publish it as open-source. Please check what's missing and help me set up the remaining files. I'll confirm yes to LICENSE (Apache-2.0), CODE_OF_CONDUCT, CONTRIBUTING, and issue templates. Skip git initialization since it's already a git repo. For badges, I want PyPI version and license badges. Assume owner 'bobcoder' and repo 'data-validator'.
evals.expected_output: Existing README preserved and enhanced. New files generated: LICENSE (Apache-2.0), CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
